faq_heading: Homes near Crescent Heights Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Crescent Heights Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Crescent Heights Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Crescent Heights Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Crescent Heights Academy. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 2 km away.
